images.name: 办公室之门
images.prompt:
Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 opening cover for the Chinese pitch presentation of 企er, an enterprise research assistant that compares company claims against records. A flat slide cover artwork, not a laptop or screen mockup. Full-bleed landscape canvas exactly 16:9, high resolution. The attached reference 1 is the APPROVED BRAND ICON, a cream goose in navy suit holding a brass magnifier: use its recognizable identity, face, tuft and magnifier faithfully. Reference 2 is the actual office environment: navy archive cabinets, warm wood, cream paper, brass desk lamps. Main palette cabinet navy #222E39, warm paper ivory #F7F0E0, brass #B88B4C, pale gold #E2BC78, wood only in scene materials. Warm, professional, distinct, approachable; thoughtful premium editorial art direction and large negative space. Do not make a busy advertisement. Only the following exact text, beautifully set with accurate Chinese glyphs in modern sans-serif:
Project wordmark "企er" (large and prominent).
Main line "查企业，也查它的说法".
Subtitle "有出处的企业研究助手".
Small optional footer "汇集公开记录 · 对照企业说法 · 生成研究报告".
No other text, no QR code, no fake date, no team names, no pitch event claims, no safety ratings, no certifications. The brand icon may be small by wordmark but avoid duplicated giant goose characters. Clearly readable presentation typography from the back of a room, generous 6% safe margins, little text, careful baseline alignment. Avoid fluorescent greens, neon purple, glassmorphism, AI sparkles, generic tech grids, charts with invented statistics, ornate serif, heavy bevelled gold typography, grunge or clutter. Preserve material connection with the actual office, while expressing the following DISTINCT layout: A cinematic invitation into the research office. Strong asymmetric two-part composition: left 45% matte navy quiet typography field, with enormous ivory wordmark 企er, brass short line, large cream main line and smaller pale gold subtitle. Right 55% a beautifully lit illustration of the actual research office extending to the slide edges, elegant wood desk in foreground, blue cabinets and warm brass lamp, one suited goose examining papers with its magnifier. Seamless subtle dark transition between type area and room, NOT a hard generic split-card layout. Illustration detailed but subdued, typography clean and calm. Tiny approved icon near a lower brand signoff only if it improves hierarchy; do not duplicate the main goose as a large extra element. This should feel like entering our product's warm office.
